panels.description: Adrian’s hidden workshop with Alex small among blueprints, mechanical models, water diagrams, analog gauges and riveted pre-Alpha pipes. A perfectly organized workbench holds the covered, completely dormant Bi11bot and Adrian’s watch face down beside it. Bi11bot has dark optics, a dark chest seam and no amber pulse; only dust and ordinary warm workshop reflections are visible. Keep upper-left open.
Alex turns the worn steel watch over, revealing Adrian’s engraved equation. The watch has no glow. Keep upper-right clear.
The chalkboard equation matches the watch engraving. Silent and unobstructed.

The covered robot remains completely still. Alex’s open hand reaches toward the sheet without touching it; the watch lies face down with its dark display visible. No amber reflection, pulse or activation cue. Keep the workbench clear.
